about: Strategy Tester jobs for the tester agent (tools/autopilot/prompts/tester.md). It runs queued jobs on Terminal 16 in the weekend window (Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 18:00 local), one at a time, in this order. status: queued | running | done | failed | hold (hold waits for the approval in needs). from/to (yyyy.MM.dd) bound a run; a job without to runs to the day it starts and cannot be repeated exactly. A job with months {from, to} (yyyy.MM) is a series of one fresh-deposit run per calendar month through tools/run-months.ps1 (the 5x EA's test); its folder is the _months folder.
